svg.title: Four-Week Funding and Scaling Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-funding-and-scaling-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Four-Week Funding and Scaling Roadmap; subtitle: Bankroll, entity, exit and calendar before sale season; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Set the Bankroll and Start Transfers; deliverable: At least $20,000 to $25,000 earmarked; custodian transfers started, since moves out of Equity Trust take two to three weeks.; gate: No sale-season bidding on $500; funds in motion before Illinois sales open in October.; week: Week 2; title: Stand Up the Bidding Entity; deliverable: Bids in the IRA's exact name with its own TIN and bank account; one Wyoming lien LLC paired with one LLC per deed.; gate: Bidding site accepts the entity and its account.; week: Week 3; title: Lock the Exit and REO Offload; deliverable: Exit strategy fixed before any maximum bid; REO offload channel proven for Georgia and Texas, where REO rates run at least 60%.; gate: Maximum bid written down with no room for auction fever.; week: Week 4; title: Calendar Notices and Budget Counsel; deliverable: Every noticing deadline calendared with proof of delivery; $2,000 to $5,000 per property reserved for a tax attorney's clear title action.; gate: Subsequent-tax payments planned to keep control of each lien.; caption: Funding engines run through self-directed retirement money, entity wrappers and other people's money, such as 10% notes funding 20% Georgia redemptions.; assumptions note: The four-week sequence is an organizing frame. Stephen Morel says matching bank-level 15-18% yields takes six to seven figures because institutions absorb roughly 80% of delinquent liens.; note: Sources: REtipster with Ted Thomas (jDYlxXpw-e4 @ 00:36:45, 00:41:33); Platinum Investment Properties Group - Tax Liens (AcKbZeNuPr4 @ 00:21:38, 00:50:34); CamaPlan Self Directed IRA (U08uLxrDVE4 @ 00:36:29; DHgFebJCtQU @ 00:18:45); Ross Budrakey (VmzztAnZ71w @ 00:36:42, 01:24:13); Kevin Bupp - Cash Flow Investor (UyiZp8ocowM @ 00:14:17, 00:39:08).

text.title: Assumptions: The four-week sequence is an organizing frame. Stephen Morel says matching bank-level 15-18% yields takes six to seven figures because institutions absorb roughly 80% of delinquent liens.
